# rubrik_aws_kms_key_manager (Data Source)

The `rubrik_aws_kms_key_manager` data source is used to look up a single AWS KMS
key manager registered in RSC, by name or by ID.

A key manager is a stored connection profile giving RSC access to a customer
owned key management service. Its ID is generated by RSC and is the value
archival locations refer to the key manager by, alongside the ID of the key
itself, which comes from AWS.

~> **Note:** Key managers are registered in the RSC UI, under Settings,
   Security, Encryption Management. There is no Terraform resource for
   registering one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an AWS KMS key manager by the name it was registered with in RSC.
data "rubrik_aws_kms_key_manager" "production" {
  name = "Production AWS KMS"
}

# A key manager can also be looked up by ID, to read the rest of its details.
data "rubrik_aws_kms_key_manager" "by_id" {
  id = "8d2d0ee8-6b5a-4a58-b2a1-cd0b5f4ee2a4"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) RSC key manager ID (UUID). This is the value archival locations refer to the key manager by. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be specified.
- `name` (String) Key manager name. Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_account_id` (String) RSC cloud account ID backing the key manager. Empty unless `provisioning_method` is `CLOUD_ACCOUNT_PROVISION`.
- `data_locations_count` (Number) Number of data locations encrypted with keys from this key manager.
- `description` (String) Key manager description.
- `iam_role_arn` (String) IAM role ARN.
- `natural_id` (String) Identifier of whatever the key manager connects to, in AWS terms. Not an RSC ID: the IAM role ARN for a directly provisioned key manager and the RSC cloud account ID for a cloud account provisioned one.
- `provisioning_method` (String) How RSC obtains the credentials it reaches AWS KMS with. Possible values are `CLOUD_ACCOUNT_PROVISION` and `DIRECT_PROVISION`.
- `region` (String) AWS region of the key management service, as its display name.
